subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should the Feishu plugin adopt this permanent default-off, process-local `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` contract with channel-level inheritance and per-account overrides?
rationale: Code review can validate the implementation, but only Feishu ownership can accept the lasting public configuration and bounded process-local delivery guarantee.

options.title: Accept bounded contract
options.body: Approve after refreshing generated metadata, documenting process-local and covered-send semantics, and adding live configured Feishu proof.

options.title: Narrow the public promise
options.body: Expose pacing only for explicitly named message create/reply surfaces and track any broader guarantee separately.

options.title: Defer to shared pacing
options.body: Pause this PR if the desired guarantee must coordinate across gateway processes or channels.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded contract
recommendation.body: Approve after refreshing generated metadata, documenting process-local and covered-send semantics, and adding live configured Feishu proof.
